NIBBLES.name: PRAWN CRACKERS
NIBBLES.description: With a sweet chilli dipping sauce.

SHARING STARTERS.name: MIXED STARTER
SHARING STARTERS.description: Perfect for sharing. A combination of our skewered chicken satay, khanom jeeb (steamed dumplings), prawn tempura, and vegetable spring rolls. Served with a selection of sauces and relishes.

SHARING STARTERS.name: AROMATIC DUCK
SHARING STARTERS.description: Crispy duck served with pancakes, and julienned cucumber, carrot, and spring onion. Comes with hoisin sauce.

SHARING STARTERS.name: MIXED VEGETARIAN
SHARING STARTERS.description: Combination of vegetable spring roll, vegetable pocket, vegetable tempura, and deep-fried tofu. Served with sauce and relish selection.

STARTERS.name: PHO PIA
STARTERS.description: Spring roll made with vegetables, vermicelli, and carrot, served with sweet chilli sauce.

STARTERS.name: VEGETABLE TEMPURA
STARTERS.description: Fried mixed vegetables coated in a crispy batter, served with sweet chilli sauce.

STARTERS.name: THAI VEGETABLE POCKET
STARTERS.description: A parcel of crispy pastry filled with vegetables, served with sweet chilli sauce.

STARTERS.name: CHICKEN SATAY
STARTERS.description: Skewered chicken breast marinated with lemongrass and other Thai herbs, served with a rich and crunchy peanut sauce.

STARTERS.name: PRAWN ON TOAST
STARTERS.description: Fried French bread, brushed with eggs, and coated with seasoned minced shrimp, coated with sesame seeds.

STARTERS.name: PRAWN TEMPURA
STARTERS.description: Prawns coated and deep-fried in a crispy batter, served with a sweet chilli dipping sauce.

STARTERS.name: SEE KRONG MOO OB
STARTERS.description: Tender, fall-off-the-bone pork spare ribs coated in a rich barbecue sauce, topped with sesame seeds and spring onions.

STARTERS.name: KHANOM JEEB
STARTERS.description: Steamed Thai dumplings filled with pork, prawns, and water chestnut. Garnished with spring onions, crispy garlic, and served with sweet soya sauce.

STARTERS.name: PHO PIA PED
STARTERS.description: Crispy roasted duck inside a spring roll with vegetables, comes with hoisin sauce.

STARTERS.name: TOD MUN PLA
STARTERS.description: Thai fish cakes, fried until crispy, made from red curry paste, fragrant lime leaves, and green beans, served with a crunchy, sweet dipping sauce.

STARTERS.name: GAI GRUB GROB
STARTERS.description: Crispy fried chicken breast bites, drizzled in sweet plum sauce and hot sriracha.

STARTERS.name: BPUU NIM
STARTERS.description: Battered soft-shell crab, fried until crispy. Garnished with slices of fresh chilli, spring onion, and coriander. Served with a hot sriracha sauce.

STARTERS.name: CHILLI SQUID
STARTERS.description: Our Thai calamari – squid coated in a light, crispy batter. Garnished with slices of fresh chilli, spring onion, and coriander. Served with a hot sriracha sauce.

SOUPS.name: TOM YUM
SOUPS.description: A traditional and popular spicy, sour, and clear soup, flavoured with lemongrass, galangal, and lime leaves, served with mushrooms and tomatoes in a fragrant Tom Yum paste.

SOUPS.name: TOM KHA
SOUPS.description: A mild and creamy coconut soup, flavoured with various aromatics including lemongrass, galangal, mushroom, and lime leaves.

SOUPS.name: PO TAK (mixed seafood)
SOUPS.description: A sour and spicy mixed seafood soup containing squid, mussels, and prawns in a broth infused with fresh chilli, lemongrass, galangal, and zesty lime leaves.

THAI SALAD.name: SOM TAM THAI (papaya)
THAI SALAD.description: Our signature shredded green papaya salad with carrots, green beans, tomatoes, chilli, crushed garlic, and ground peanuts. Hand pounded in a mortar and pestle with a tangy lime and fish sauce dressing.

THAI SALAD.name: YUM NEUA (beef)
THAI SALAD.description: Strips of grilled sirloin steak on top of a salad with our dressing seasoned with lemongrass, shallots, cherry tomato, pepper, spring onions, mint, and celery.

THAI SALAD.name: YUM TALAY (seafood)
THAI SALAD.description: Our seafood salad comprising king prawns, mussels, and squid, with our house dressing infused with lemongrass, shallots, cherry tomato, pepper, mint, and celery.

THAI SALAD.name: SOM TAM PLA RA (papaya with fermented fish sauce)
THAI SALAD.description: Our spicy shredded green papaya salad made North-Eastern (Isaan) style with a spicy dressing and pla ra (fermented fish sauce). Note: We do not recommend ordering this mild, as the spice is essential to balance the intense flavour of the fermented fish.

THAI SALAD.name: GOONG CHAE NAM PLA (raw prawns)
THAI SALAD.description: Fresh raw prawns coated in a spicy and tangy fish sauce and lime dressing. Garnished with fresh mint. Note: This dish features 100% raw seafood cured in citrus. Only recommended for those who are accustomed to raw shellfish.

THAI SALAD.name: Laab (minced meat)
THAI SALAD.description: A North-Eastern minced meat salad tossed with fresh mint, chilli, coriander, lime juice, and toasted rice powder. Served cold with lettuce.

CURRIES.name: GAENG DAENG (red curry)
CURRIES.description: A medium curry with bamboo shoots, courgette, and fresh chilli. Made from curry paste flavoured with dried red chilli and Thai herbs, offering a sweet, earthy taste, cooked in coconut milk.

CURRIES.name: GAENG KIEW WAAN (green curry)
CURRIES.description: A traditional medium curry with bamboo shoots and courgette, garnished with sweet basil. Made from curry paste infused with Thai aromatics, and fresh green chilli, cooked in coconut milk.

CURRIES.name: GAENG PANAENG
CURRIES.description: A medium, thick curry with green beans, topped with shredded makrut lime leaves. Made from a herby, aromatic paste cooked in coconut milk offering a creamy, mild flavour.

CURRIES.name: GAENG PA (jungle curry)
CURRIES.description: A spicy and herbaceous curry cooked without coconut milk in a clear and fiery red broth with bamboo shoots and baby corn, seasoned with lemongrass and galangal.

CURRIES.name: GAENG MASSAMAN
CURRIES.description: A sweet, mild, Southern Thai curry. It's cooked with coconut milk, potato, onion, dry spices, and garnished with crispy shallots. The popular beef option is served tender and slow cooked.

STIR-FRIED DISHES.name: PAD KRA PAO (chilli and basil)
STIR-FRIED DISHES.description: A Thai favourite: fried chilli and garlic in savoury sauce with green beans and onion, topped with aromatic holy basil.

STIR-FRIED DISHES.name: PAD KHING (ginger)
STIR-FRIED DISHES.description: A mild stir-fry with julienned fresh ginger, onion, shitake mushroom, and sliced spring onion, in savoury sauce.

STIR-FRIED DISHES.name: PAD PRIEW WAAN (sweet and sour)
STIR-FRIED DISHES.description: Our Thai-style thick sweet and sour sauce with courgette, onion, tomatoes, pineapple, and spring onion.

STIR-FRIED DISHES.name: PAD NUMMAN HOI (oyster sauce)
STIR-FRIED DISHES.description: Stir-fry in oyster sauce with black pepper, baby corn, onion, mushroom, and spring onion.

STIR-FRIED DISHES.name: PAD MED MA-MUANG (cashew nut)
STIR-FRIED DISHES.description: Stir-fried toasted cashew nuts with onion, carrot, and dried chilli, in a savoury and nutty sauce.

VEGETABLE DISHES.name: PAD PAK RUAM MIT
VEGETABLE DISHES.description: Seasonal vegetables in garlic, including carrot, mushroom, mangetout, and baby corn.

VEGETABLE DISHES.name: PAD BROCOLLI
VEGETABLE DISHES.description: Stir-fried broccoli with soy sauce, oyster sauce, and garlic.

VEGETABLE DISHES.name: PAD PAK KIEW
VEGETABLE DISHES.description: Seasonal green vegetables in garlic, including spring greens, broccoli, and mangetout.

CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.name: SUA RONG HAI (weeping tiger steak)
CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.description: Our signature Thai-style grilled strips of sirloin steak served with onion and our house sauce on a sizzling hot plate.

CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.name: PED MA KHAM
CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.description: Roasted duck in a sweet tamarind sauce served on a bed of spring greens and topped with crispy shallots on a hot plate.

CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.name: GAENG PHED PED YANG (duck curry)
CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.description: Tender slices of roasted duck cooked in red curry with pineapple, tomatoes and sweet lychee.

CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.name: GOONG PAOW
CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.description: Our sizzling charcoal grilled king prawns, served with a chilli, garlic, and lime dipping sauce.

CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.name: GOONG MAKHAM
CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.description: Grilled king prawns served sizzling with a sweet tamarind sauce, and garnished with crispy shallots.

CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.name: GOONG PAD PHONG KAREE
CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.description: King prawns with curry powder, celery, eggs, onion, and tomatoes in a mild yellow curry sauce.

CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.name: PLA NUNG MANOW
CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.description: Soft and flaky steamed seabass in our fresh garlic, lime, and chilli sauce.

CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.name: PLA NUNG SIEW
CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.description: Steamed seabass in soya sauce, topped with fresh ginger, shiitake mushroom, julienned spring onion, and chopped coriander.

CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.name: CHU CHEE PLA
CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.description: Crispy battered seabass topped with a thick and creamy red curry and coconut sauce, shredded lime leaves, and sweet basil.

CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.name: PLA MAKHAM
CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.description: Battered seabass drizzled in a sweet tamarind sauce and garnished with crispy fried shallots.

CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.name: PLA SAM ROD
CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.description: “Three-flavour fish” – our battered seabass in our signature sweet, sour, and mildly spicy sauce containing crushed chilli and garlic, diced bell peppers, and topped with sweet Horapha basil.

CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.name: PAD CHAO LAY
CHEF'S RECOMMENDATIONS.description: Our spicy mixed seafood stir-fry with fresh Thai herbs, chillies, garlic, and peppercorns. Enquire for current seafood availability.

NOODLES AND RICE MAINS.name: PAD THAI
NOODLES AND RICE MAINS.description: Surbiton's favourite! Our very popular and traditional stir-fried rice noodles with eggs, bean sprouts, spring onion, stir-fried in a sweet radish and tamarind sauce, and served with crushed peanut.

NOODLES AND RICE MAINS.name: PAD KI-MAO
NOODLES AND RICE MAINS.description: (drunken noodles) Stir-fried wide Hofun rice noodle with chilli, green beans, bamboo shoots, pepper, onions, and basil leaves, in a savoury sauce.

NOODLES AND RICE MAINS.name: PAD BA-MI
NOODLES AND RICE MAINS.description: (egg noodles) Stir-fried egg noodles with beansprouts, spring onions, eggs, and soy sauce.

NOODLES AND RICE MAINS.name: PAD SIEW
NOODLES AND RICE MAINS.description: Stir-fried wide Hofun rice noodle with eggs and spring greens in a sweetened dark soy sauce.

NOODLES AND RICE MAINS.name: KHAO PAD ROD FAI
NOODLES AND RICE MAINS.description: (special fried rice) – 1 day old jasmine rice cooked and browned in a wok, with dark soy sauce, spring greens, onion, tomato, and egg.

NOODLES AND RICE MAINS.name: KHAO PAD SAPPAROD
NOODLES AND RICE MAINS.description: Pineapple fried rice cooked with dried raisins, cashew nut, onion, pineapple, and curry powder.

SIDE DISHES.name: KHAO GATI
SIDE DISHES.description: Steamed jasmine rice cooked in coconut milk, topped with coconut flakes.

SIDE DISHES.name: PLAIN NOODLE
SIDE DISHES.description: Boiled thin rice noodles, topped with beansprouts and crispy garlic.

DESSERTS.name: ICE CREAM
DESSERTS.description: Choose from Coconut, Thai Tea, or Green Tea flavour

DESSERTS.name: BLOOD ORANGE SORBET
DESSERTS.description: Made using blood oranges, with a balance of sweetness and bitterness.

DESSERTS.name: MINT CHOCOLATE BOMB
DESSERTS.description: Mint ice cream with a chocolate centre and coating with mint pieces.

DESSERTS.name: MANGO STICKY RICE
DESSERTS.description: SUBJECT TO AVAILABILITY. Classic Thai dessert with sticky rice infused with sweetened coconut milk, served alongside fresh mango slices topped with toasted sesame seeds.

SET MENU A.name: Starter: Nay Thai Mixed Starter
SET MENU A.description: A combination of our skewered chicken satay, khanom jeeb (steamed dumplings), prawn tempura, and vegetable spring rolls. Served with a selection of sauces and relishes.

SET MENU A.name: Main Course: Chicken Green Curry
SET MENU A.description: cooked in coconut milk with bamboo shoots and courgette, garnished with sweet basil.

SET MENU A.name: Main Course: Stir-fried Beef in Oyster Sauce
SET MENU A.description: with black pepper, baby corn, onion, mushroom, and spring onion.

SET MENU A.name: Main Course: Prawn Pad Thai
SET MENU A.description: with thin rice noodles, eggs, bean sprouts, spring onion, stir-fried in a sweet radish and tamarind sauce, and served with crushed peanut.

SET MENU B.name: Starter: Aromatic Duck
SET MENU B.description: Crispy duck served with pancakes, and julienned cucumber, carrot, and spring onion. Comes with hoisin sauce.

SET MENU B.name: Main Course: Chicken Massaman Curry
SET MENU B.description: A sweet, mild, Southern Thai curry. It's cooked with coconut milk, potato, onion, dry spices, and garnished with crispy shallots.

SET MENU B.name: Main Course: Pad Chao Lay
SET MENU B.description: Our spicy mixed seafood stir-fry with fresh Thai herbs, chillies, garlic, and peppercorns.

SET MENU C.name: Starter: Tom Yum Soup with Prawns
SET MENU C.description: A traditional and popular spicy, sour, and clear soup, flavoured with lemongrass, galangal, and lime leaves, served with mushrooms and tomatoes in a fragrant Tom Yum paste.
